title: Port Build 7 ECR -2 to Build 8: Flrt3: Horn state doesn't change on brake/horn interface screen
executive_summary: This change fixes a UI problem where the Horn state field on the brake/horn interface screen doesn't update to Active when the Horn key is pressed on SR-FLRT3-DMU trains, even though it works correctly on other screens and on SR-KSS_EMU trains. The fix directly affects the Brake System Interface component and indirectly affects the Crew Display HMI and Locomotive Interface Gateway. You should run seven tests across two requirements: two P0 tests that directly validate Horn key press on the brake/horn interface screen and Horn state behavior for SR-FLRT3-DMU specifically, plus five P1 tests covering Horn key press and release, SR-KSS_EMU control type comparison, and diagnostic screen details. Four of the P1 tests need more clarity about exactly what Horn state field behavior they're checking on the brake/horn interface screen.

ecr_overview.title: Port Build 7 ECR -2 to Build 8: Flrt3: Horn state doesn't change on brake/horn interface screen
ecr_overview.description:
When the Horn key is pressed on the "brake/horn interface" screen, Ob doesn't update the Horn state field to Active, and it continues to show Inactive on the screen.

This is working fine on "EBI Slot 6 - EBI Onboard Diagnostics" and "System Test - Brakes" Screen.

This issue is only observed for SR-FLRT3-DMU. For SR-KSS_EMU, Ob is working correctly.
ecr_overview.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Set control type SR-FLRT3-DMU and bring OB to cutout
2. Open OB diagnostic screen
3. Go to the Brake/Horn interface row and press the show details key
4. Ensure OB displays the Brake/Horn interface screen
5. Press the Horn key
6. Observe OB keep showing Horn state as Inactive
ecr_overview.observed_behavior: On pressing the Horn key, OB keeps showing the Horn state field status as Inactive
ecr_overview.expected_behavior: OB should update the horn state field as Active

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: This change fixes a UI problem where the Horn state field on the brake/horn interface screen doesn't update to Active when the Horn key is pressed on SR-FLRT3-DMU trains, even though it works correctly on other screens and on SR-KSS_EMU trains. The fix directly affects the Brake System Interface component and indirectly affects the Crew Display HMI and Locomotive Interface Gateway. You should run seven tests across two requirements: two P0 tests that directly validate Horn key press on the brake/horn interface screen and Horn state behavior for SR-FLRT3-DMU specifically, plus five P1 tests covering Horn key press and release, SR-KSS_EMU control type comparison, and diagnostic screen details. Four of the P1 tests need more clarity about exactly what Horn state field behavior they're checking on the brake/horn interface screen.
